verdict: No blocking defect identified after mandatory endpoint and sample-clock guards were added. This static review does not replace supervisor, freeze, binary, authorization or actual new-parity checks.

checks.finding: Explicit contact-diagnostic operation; missing or unknown operation refuses. The full-transfer branch remains separate, and its permit requirements cannot consume the 568-step diagnostic permits.

Exact nonrenewable worker reservation: 52 technical steps plus 516 history steps (36 prefix plus at most one 480-step forecast), total 568. Both permits require distinct IDs, one PID, same deadline, and no prior worker reservation. Native remaining-wall permits are capped at 113 seconds.
Both technical copy/actual pairs must pass before a NativeKernelAdmission is returned. The new diagnostic invokes this technical procedure itself; old parity is not imported as qualification.

After the first forecast, refusal returns an error. Otherwise ContactDiagnostic validates one requested horizon and exactly 36 main-prefix steps, sets diagnostic_completed, then returns before certify_transfer_horizon, admit_transfer_window or the actual-step loop.
Worker accepts one request and then requires EOF; every second request is refused. Durable cross-process claim and supervisor deadline enforcement remain external prelaunch obligations.

The only new projection is exact path support.native_contact_boundary. Existing kind and absent/null owner.transfer exclusions are unchanged. No recursive name filtering or MaterialPatch fields are removed. All remaining old fields retain bit-sensitive comparison, including signed zero and unknown fields.

Before projection, live native_contact_boundary must deserialize, have schema1, match both native clocks, contain 25 pairs and preserve canonical segment order. Full new telemetry remains in the archived native frames and preview-step support payload.

copy_static_snapshot clones coordination directly with source.coordination.clone(). The newly non-deserializable continuity cache is therefore preserved in native preview copies without JSON round trips.

The reviewed patch modifies worker routing, accounting, additive telemetry comparison and pure tests only. Support thresholds, contact matching, drift envelope, actuator contract, native integration and anatomy files examined remain byte-identical to the authorized base.

Diagnostic outcome has separate diagnostic_completed and no_real_transfer fields. It does not label the run history_completed, local_success or original_terminal_passed. The eight real technical counterparts remain part of the 52-step technical budget; no_real_transfer concerns the main history after A36.

Diagnostic completion now requires a validated SupportObservation, contact-boundary schema1, matching native endpoint clocks, all25 canonical segments and LocalSupportSample.native_substep equal to the same endpoint clock. Missing, stale or incomplete evidence returns a refusal before diagnostic_completed. Endpoint validation refusal retains the original preview refusal/execution error in the trace and returned error; it introduces no retry.

limits: The global 120-second envelope includes process startup, output collection and shutdown and must be enforced by the supervisor; the Rust gate limits native permits to at most113 seconds. Supervisor/manifest files are outside this worker-only review.
No new native parity, forecast outcome, point-loss cause, local success, standing continuation or stability has been measured by this review.
The full telemetry increases serialization time and volume. The authorized wall cap and exact journal accounting must close the run if exhausted; no retry or automatic budget extension is implied.
Historical prefix fields retain exact comparison, but the additive telemetry has no old counterpart. Its new native parity and data validity must be checked on the authorized run.

On an already refused forecast, the local diagnostic sample may legitimately remain atN-1 while support and native_contact_boundary describe current endpointN. The strict endpoint guard may then add a secondary refusal. Analysis must retain and distinguish the original forecast cause from this endpoint-evidence refusal; it must not reinterpret current body/contact data as stale or request an automatic retry.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Diagnostic endpoint observation, complete contact-boundary telemetry and a diagnostic sample are now mandatory before success.
